يعتزلان (form VIII)
# يَعْتَزِلَانِ (yaʕtazilāni) /jaʕ.ta.zi.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past active indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
# يُعْتَزَلَانِ (yuʕtazalāni) /juʕ.ta.za.laː.ni/: third-person masculine dual non-past passive indicative of اِعْتَزَلَ (iʕtazala)
